description: This source file implements a traverser class for transforming embedded uniform structs into named declarations within a shader compiler's AST, facilitating easier management of uniform block declarations.

classes.name: Traverser
classes.description: A class that traverses the AST to convert embedded uniform structs into named declarations for easier management.

methods.name: visitDeclaration
methods.description: Visits declaration nodes to identify and replace unnamed uniform struct declarations.

methods.name: doReplacement
methods.description: Performs the replacement of unnamed uniform struct declarations with named declarations.
